title: Aromatic Pillowy Uruguayan Rice Bake
description: A savory Uruguayan dish with pillowy texture featuring white sauerkraut and energizing ingredients. This gluten-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: White Sauerkraut
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, drained, rinse if canned

instructions: In a large bowl, combine rice, sauerkraut, chicken broth, and olive oil.
In a large skillet, saut 5 onion and garlic until softened.
Add ground beef and chorizo, cook until browned, breaking up chunks with spatula.
Transfer the skillet mixture to a 6-quart donabe or clay pot.
Add paprika, salt, and black pepper to the donabe, stir to combine.
Cover the donabe with a tight-fitting lid and transfer to a preheated oven at 3751F (1901C).
Bake for 25 minutes, then reduce heat to 3251F (1601C) and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes.
Remove the donabe from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork before serving.
Garnish with diced onion, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
